title: 1905 Prairie: the Marshall Field house stands
items: Marshall Field's house at 1905 Prairie Avenue is no longer a plain draft block: two storeys of brick over a light stone basement, a tall slated mansard with dormers and iron cresting, the door in its second bay, the curved conservatory on the south side and the scroll-pattern iron fence, built from Rand McNally's 1893 Pictorial Chicago photograph.
Still to come: the canted south-west corner the photograph shows, the iron balconies and the conservatory's glass roof.
